data.name: Gopal
data.gender_notes: Gopal is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit go, 'cow', + pāla, 'protector' — 'protector of cows'. Its root is Sanskrit go + pāla. An epithet of Krishna. Gopal is a Sanskrit name meaning “Cowherd; protector of cows”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gopal expresses “Cowherd; protector of cows”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit go, 'cow', + pāla, 'protector' — 'protector of cows'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gopal total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
